text: Yo! New quest unlocked. Cook the perfect pasta!
Step one. Fill a big pot, and bring it to a rolling boil.
Step two. Salt the water. Generously! Plus ten flavor.
Step three. Drop in the pasta, and stir so it doesn't stick.
Step four. Cook one minute less than the box says. Al dente, unlocked!
Step five. Save a mug of pasta water. It's the secret item.
Toss it with sauce, and a splash of that water. Quest complete!
